entries.0d2e7a1854bd59bd: THE TOHOKU BANK,LTD. is a regional bank headquartered in Morioka, Iwate Prefecture, and consists of the Bank, two consolidated subsidiaries and one unconsolidated subsidiary not accounted for under the equity method.
entries.17ac0b7d528bfd52: It operates mainly in Iwate Prefecture and provides financial services mainly to small and medium-sized business customers and individual customers, who form the core of the regional economy.
entries.2108a2b2a54eb783: Through its head office, 54 branches and 2 sub-branches, it conducts deposit, lending, trading in securities held for trading, securities investment, domestic exchange and corporate bond trustee operations, and also conducts incidental operations such as over-the-counter sales of government and other public bonds and investment trusts; its consolidated subsidiaries handle leasing and credit card operations.
entries.25ac00e2463f842f: By reportable segment, the composition of ordinary income for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was dominated by the Banking Business at ¥16,257 million, followed by the Leasing Business at ¥1,212 million and Other (Credit Card Business) at ¥462 million.
